toolsPreview.name: search_companies_by_technologies
toolsPreview.description: Find companies using the given technologies, ranked by usage. Names are case-insensitive ('snowflake' == 'Snowflake'); 10,000+ technologies are tracked (use list_technologies to explore). match='any' needs at least one technology, 'all' needs every one.

toolsPreview.name: get_company_by_domain
toolsPreview.description: Resolve a company domain (e.g. 'walgreens.com') to its full profile: firmographics, hiring stats, and the technology stack with adoption context (using / adopting / replacing / evaluating).

toolsPreview.name: list_technologies
toolsPreview.description: Catalog of all technologies in the dataset with per-technology company counts. sort='count' (most used first) or 'name'.
